

---

HOW TO IMPORT:

1. Copy the text above (the long encrypted string)
2. Open Streamerbot
3. Go to Import/Export → Import
4. Paste the string and click Import
5. Enable the "GT7 Vote" action
6. Make sure your GT7 server is running on port 3000
7. Test with: !vote 1

This action will:
- Listen for !vote commands in YouTube chat
- Parse the position (1-16)
- Extract voter username and avatar
- Send vote to your GT7 voting server
- Handle errors gracefully

Note: Make sure the GT7 Position Voting server is running before testing!
